ui.tagline: Professional online toolbox — 900 tools in one site
ui.hero_title: Every tool you need, right here
ui.hero_sub: No sign-up, no server — everything runs on your own device.
ui.empty: No tools have been added yet. The first tool is coming soon.
ui.footer_text: POOF2 — Built by Muse · Version v{version}

word-counter.name: Word & Character Counter
word-counter.description: Live count of characters, words, sentences, paragraphs and reading time — nothing is sent to a server.

case-converter.name: English Case Converter
case-converter.description: Convert English text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case and back — on your own device.

trim-spaces.name: Remove Extra Spaces
trim-spaces.description: Turn multiple spaces into one, tidy lines and remove empty lines.

text-to-slug.name: Text to Slug
text-to-slug.description: Turn a title into a clean slug for links, with your chosen separator.

age-calculator.name: Precise Age Calculator
age-calculator.description: Exact age in years, months and days, days lived, weekday of birth and days until your next birthday.

bmi-calculator.name: BMI Calculator
bmi-calculator.description: Body mass index, weight category, healthy weight range for your height, and how much to gain or lose — on your own device.

percent-discount.name: Percent and Discount Calculator
percent-discount.description: Discount amount, final price, percent of a number, and the original price from a discounted price — on your own device.

weight-converter.name: Weight Unit Converter
weight-converter.description: Convert weight between kilograms, grams, milligrams, tonnes, pounds, ounces and stone — on your own device.

length-converter.name: Length Unit Converter
length-converter.description: Convert between millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards and miles — on your own device.

temperature-converter.name: Temperature Unit Converter
temperature-converter.description: Convert temperature between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin — with a conversion challenge game, timer and points.

mental-math-challenge.name: Mental Math Speed Challenge
mental-math-challenge.description: Mental addition, subtraction, multiplication and division with quick tricks — practice, beat your record, earn XP.
